title: WalEntry
description: One line in cf-sync-wal.jsonl. Written by _wal_log(), read by cmd_wal_inspect() and cmd_wal_replay(). Crash-durable: each entry is fsynced before _wal_log() returns. Malformed lines are skipped by all readers (tolerance by design).

id.description: Monotonically increasing within a daemon instance. Restored from line count on restart (_init_wal_seq). Not globally unique across restarts — ids continue from prior count, so gaps are possible after _wal_trim().

op.description: Intended CF operation. Note: cmd_wal_inspect and cmd_wal_replay currently read 'action' instead of 'op' — they always see '?' / '' (known bug, documented).

target.description: IP address, CIDR block, or 'full' for reconcile ops.

tag.description: CF rule note tag (e.g. 'crowdsec-local-ban', 'modsec-ban'). Empty string when not applicable.

ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime with UTC offset, written by datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().

dry_run.description: True when CF_DRY_RUN=1; the operation was not actually applied.
